doan_van.ten: Truyện — Chiếc điện thoại của ông
doan_van.noi_dung: Last year, my grandfather received a bright blue smartphone from my family for his seventieth birthday. Before that special day, he used a very old mobile phone that was made in 2010. He always believed that modern electronic devices were not designed for older people. However, my sister Mai kindly decided to help him learn how to use the new phone. First, she carefully showed him how the large touch screen worked. Then, a helpful news application was downloaded so he could read daily newspapers easily. This useful software was developed by a famous technology company in Vietnam. The phone was launched two years ago, but its speed is still very fast. Yesterday, the system software was updated automatically during the night. My grandfather was very happy because the phone connected to the internet much faster after the update. In the past, he thought that scientists only invented complicated machines for young students. Now, he discovers wonderful videos about cooking and gardening online every morning. Last week, the old battery was replaced because it became quite weak. While the device was being repaired at the store, my grandfather missed it a lot. Modern technology really improves his daily life and keeps him happy every day.

phat_am:
- **invented** /ɪnˈventɪd/ — đuôi /ɪd/ vì sau âm /t/.
- **designed** /dɪˈzaɪnd/ — đuôi /d/, chữ “g” câm.
- **battery** /ˈbætri/ — 2 âm tiết trong Anh-Anh, nuốt chữ “e”.
luu_y:
**① Chọn was/were theo CHỦ NGỮ MỚI (vật), không theo người làm.**

- The phone **was** invented… / The phones **were** made…

**② Sau modal (must, can, should, will) → luôn là “be + V3”**, không chia:
✅ It **must be** repaired. · ✅ It **will be** launched. ❌ It will is launched.

**③ Bị động hoàn thành: has/have BEEN + V3** — người Việt hay quên chữ “been”.
❌ It has updated. (nghĩa: nó đã cập nhật cái gì đó) → ✅ It **has been** updated.

**④ was born — luôn ở dạng bị động.**
❌ I born in 1995. ❌ I was borned. → ✅ I **was born** in 1995.

**⑤ Câu bị động 2 tân ngữ:** *They gave me a prize* → có 2 cách:

- **I was given** a prize. (thường dùng hơn)
- A prize **was given** to me.

**⑥ Bị động rất quan trọng trong IELTS Writing Task 1 (process):**
*First, the beans **are collected**. Then they **are dried** and **packed**.*
meo:
- Toàn bộ bị động chỉ là **“be ở đúng thì + V3”**. Học 1 công thức, dùng cho 6 thì.
- Nhớ “has **been**”: chữ **been là bằng chứng của bị động** ở thì hoàn thành — thiếu nó thì câu đổi nghĩa.
- Mốc năm + bị động là cặp đôi cố định trong bài đọc: *was invented in…, was founded in…, was built in…*
